en.title: Letter codes: one step on
en.teach: In a code, every letter moves the same number of places along the alphabet. {w1} → {c1}: each letter moves {move}, so {w2} → {answer}.
en.prompt: If {w1} is written {c1}, how is {w2} written?
en.reason: Each letter moves {move} along the alphabet, so {w2} becomes {answer}.
